QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_49

answer.text: Positively skewed (long right tail, mean > mode)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Skewness > 0 indicates positive skew — long right tail and mean shifted above the mode. **The Trap:** Symmetric/normal has 0; negative skew has long left tail. **Cross-Exam Context:** Key statistical concept across X-A, XV. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Positive skew is the 'right' asymmetry — lotteries and venture capital often show it.
